rule.name: Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
rule.htmlDesc:
Cognitive Complexity is a measure of how hard the control flow of a method is to understand. Methods with high Cognitive Complexity will be difficult to maintain.

See the Cognitive Complexity white paper for more details.

How to fix it

Refactor the method to reduce branching and nested control flow. Extract helper methods where appropriate.

// Before:
if (x) { if (y) { ... } }
// After:
if (x && y) { ... }
